how_to_apply: Select the appropriate advertisement for Young Professionals or Advisors and Senior Consultants.
Proceed to the KVIC online recruitment portal.
Register using a valid mobile number and email address.
Select the relevant recruitment and position.
Enter the required personal, educational and experience details.
Provide a 200-word summary of relevant experience.
Upload the photograph, signature and supporting certificates in the prescribed format.
Review all the entered information before final submission.
Submit the application by 30 September 2026 at 11:59 PM.
Save the generated registration number and application printout.
The application must be submitted online only. Applicants are not required to send documents to KVIC by post, courier, email or by hand.

Young Professional, Advisor and Senior Consultant

content_sections.heading: KVIC Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: The number of positions is tentative and may change according to KVIC's requirements.

content_sections.heading: KVIC Young Professional Eligibility
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess a full-time postgraduate degree in the relevant field from a UGC-recognized university, recognized deemed university or an AICTE-approved institution. Internship training will not be counted as work experience. Only direct work experience, including fixed-term employment, will be considered.

rows.preferred_qualification: CA, ICWA, M.Com., M.Sc. in Accounting or Finance, MBA Finance or equivalent qualification
Postgraduate degree in a relevant field
Postgraduate degree in Textile Engineering, Textile Technology, Fashion Technology, Textile Chemistry, Handloom Technology or equivalent
Postgraduate degree in Marketing, Digital Marketing, Brand Management or equivalent
Postgraduate degree in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, Architecture or equivalent
Postgraduate degree, preferably with a Mechanical or Chemical background
Postgraduate degree in Mass Communication, Journalism, Media Studies, Public Relations, Digital Media or equivalent

content_sections.heading: KVIC Advisor Eligibility
content_sections.text: Advisor positions are open only to retired or voluntarily retired personnel from Government departments or Public Sector Undertakings. Candidates must possess at least 15 years of relevant experience. The required experience must relate to the specialization for which the candidate applies. The advertised specializations include Audit and Accounts, Administration, Estate and Services, Khadi, Legal, Marketing and SFURTI.

content_sections.heading: KVIC Senior Consultant Eligibility
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess a postgraduate or management degree and at least five years of experience in the relevant field.

rows.preferred_qualification_or_experience: CA, ICWA, MBA Finance, M.Com., M.Sc. Accounting or Finance, or equivalent with relevant experience
Postgraduate degree in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, Architecture or equivalent
Relevant postgraduate qualification with experience in Government procurement, tenders, GFR, GeM and CVC guidelines

rows.specialization: Khadi - Quality, Design, Technology and Digital Transformation
rows.preferred_qualification_or_experience: Postgraduate degree in Textile or Industrial Engineering with experience in design, quality control or lean manufacturing
CA, MBA Finance, M.Com., M.Sc. Accounting or Finance, preferably with textile-sector experience
Postgraduate degree in Textile or equivalent with experience in spinning mills
Postgraduate degree in Law with relevant experience
Postgraduate degree in Marketing, Digital Marketing or Brand Management with experience in retail, FMCG or textiles
Postgraduate degree in Computer Science, IT or ECE with experience in MIS, software, dashboards, PFMS or financial applications
Postgraduate degree preferably in Mechanical, Chemical or Textile disciplines with R&D experience and research publications
Postgraduate degree with experience in general administration, establishment matters and service rules, preferably in Government or PSU organizations

content_sections.heading: KVIC Salary Details
content_sections.text: The remuneration offered to Young Professionals and Senior Consultants will depend on their qualifications and experience. For retired or voluntarily retired Advisors, fixed remuneration will be calculated by deducting the basic pension from the last basic pay drawn at retirement. The amount will remain unchanged throughout the contract.

rows.monthly_remuneration: Rs.25,000 to Rs.30,000 plus conveyance allowance of Rs.2,500 to Rs.3,000
Rs.30,000 to Rs.40,000 plus conveyance allowance of Rs.2,500 to Rs.3,000

content_sections.heading: Contract Period
content_sections.text: The initial contractual engagement will be for one year. The contract may be extended for a further period of up to two years. Extension will depend on performance and KVIC's continuing requirements. A fresh contract must be signed for every extension. The engagement does not provide any right to permanent appointment, absorption or regularization in KVIC.

content_sections.heading: Required Skills
content_sections.text: Working knowledge of MS Word, MS Excel and MS PowerPoint Good communication and writing skills Analytical and drafting ability Ability to prepare reports, notes, presentations and official correspondence Ability to work independently and as part of a team Professional integrity and commitment to assigned responsibilities Ability to handle confidential and sensitive matters Knowledge of Government rules and procedures relevant to the selected discipline

content_sections.heading: KVIC Selection Process
content_sections.text: Screening of online applications Shortlisting based on qualification and experience Document verification Personal interview Final selection based on qualification, experience and interview performance Candidates must carry their application printout and original photo identity proof when attending the interview. KVIC will not provide TA or DA for attending the interview.

content_sections.heading: Job Location
content_sections.text: Young Professionals will be assigned to different directorates at the KVIC Central Office according to organizational requirements.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for KVIC Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The application must be submitted online only. Applicants are not required to send documents to KVIC by post, courier, email or by hand.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for Online Application
content_sections.text: Recent passport-size colour photograph Scanned signature made with a black ink pen Proof of date of birth Postgraduate degree or provisional certificate Experience certificates Relevant professional qualification certificates CGPA or grade-to-percentage conversion certificate, where applicable Valid email address and mobile number A 200-word summary of relevant experience

rows.format_and_size: JPG or JPEG, 50 KB to 100 KB
JPG or JPEG, as prescribed on the recruitment portal
JPG, JPEG or PDF, generally not exceeding 1000 KB

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Candidates must satisfy all eligibility conditions by the closing date. Only online applications will be accepted. Applicants should submit only one application for the same position. After final submission, changes may not be permitted. The registered email address and mobile number must remain active throughout the recruitment process. The candidate's name in the application must match the name on the photo identity proof. Original documents must be produced during the interview or joining process. Internship training will not be counted as work experience. Communication regarding recruitment will be provided through email and the KVIC website. Canvassing or submitting false information will result in disqualification.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: KVIC has announced 50 tentative positions, including 20 Young Professionals, 15 Advisors and 15 Senior Consultants.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 30 September 2026, up to 11:59 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary for Young Professionals?
faq.answer: Young Professionals will receive Rs.25,000 to Rs.30,000 per month plus conveyance allowance of Rs.2,500 to Rs.3,000.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for Senior Consultants?
faq.answer: Senior Consultants will receive Rs.30,000 to Rs.40,000 per month plus conveyance allowance of Rs.2,500 to Rs.3,000.

faq.question: Q5. Who can apply for Advisor posts?
faq.answer: Advisor posts are open to retired or voluntarily retired personnel from Government departments or PSUs with at least 15 years of relevant experience.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for Young Professionals?
faq.answer: Young Professional applicants must be below 27 years of age as of 1 October 2026.
